page.layout: One printed page, page number 221 at top right, running head "D. Maximiliani I." at top left. One text column with no margin notes. Roman numerals V.–IX. stand centred on their own lines, each followed by a paragraph opening in small capitals. The catchword "quæ" stands alone at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: lestoribus in Regem Rom. unanimiter ele-ctus, ac paulo post Aquisgrani adhibitis ritè ceremoniis coronatus.
IUNCTIS CUM PATRUELE SIGIS-mundo armis Roveretum oppidum expugna-tum, ac Venetorum copiæ una cum Duce Roberto Sanseverino ad vicum Callianum de-letæ.
UNIVERSA INFERIORIS AUSTRIÆ provincia, quæ una cum metropoli Vienna in potestatē Matthiæ Corvini, inclyti Hungariæ regis, devenerat, intra trium mensium spacium recuperata.
ALBA REGALIS, URBS NOBILIS-sima, in qua reges Hungariæ & inaugurari & sepeliri solent, valido exercitu cincta & expugnata, ingénsq; illi regno terror illatus.
FACTA CUM CAROLO VIII. GAL-lorum rege pace, Margarita filia una cum opulentissimis Burgundiæ ac Artesiæ Comitatibus, ante tempus à Ludovico XI. occupatis, re-cepta.

page.notes: Catchword "quæ" is at the foot right and is kept out of the text. Line-end hyphens in "ele-ctus", "SIGIS-mundo", "expugna-tum", "de-letæ", "NOBILIS-sima", "GAL-lorum" and "re-cepta" are kept as printed. "potestatē" carries the macron as printed. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout. Roman numerals V.–IX. are bare numbers, so they are written as paragraphs, not headings. No marginal notes or other furniture are printed.
